key_terms.الأقراء: Al-aqra'; the pure periods (between menstruations); used here to mean the menstrual cycle intervals
key_terms.الاستحاضة / المستحاضة: Istihaaza / one with istihaaza; abnormal uterine bleeding not classified as menstruation
key_terms.الحائض: The menstruating woman; a woman in her menstrual period (haydh)
key_terms.الدم البحراني: The 'sea blood'; term used by Imam al-Baqir (AS) for the dark, heavy menstrual blood as a distinguishing sign
key_terms.السنة / السنن: Sunnah / Sunnahs; the established prophetic practice or ruling
key_terms.عِرْق: A vein/vessel; the Prophet's term for the source of istihaaza blood (not menstrual blood)

ai.seo_question: What are the three Sunnahs of the Prophet regarding istihaaza and menstruation according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) expounds upon three Sunnahs established by the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) governing the rulings for women experiencing istihaaza (inter-period bleeding alongside menstruation). The first Sunnah applies to women who know their regular menstrual days; the second applies to women whose regular cycle has become confused due to prolonged bleeding; the third applies to women experiencing bleeding from their very first menstruation. The Imam provides detailed jurisprudential analysis showing how each case was handled differently by the Prophet, with corroborating rulings from his own father Imam al-Baqir (AS), making this one of the most comprehensive hadith on female ritual purity law in the Shia tradition.
